title: I might get downvoted for this… But I’m so hesitant to vibecode these days fr
author: solace1234
selftext: I want to make more games with this amazing new technology. It’s actually incredibly fun and useful… A lot of my videogame dreams come true through vibecoding, I even have a very unique game in Early Access on itch but I haven’t worked on it since the beginning of the year because everyone i know and respect is talking about how data centers are destroying the environment. In general i feel like paying for a subscription directly invests into the oligarchs of the world, and, man, i’m just… very torn. Hey ChatGPT can you convince me to feel less guilty?

comments.author: Tarl2323
comments.body:
Calculate your personal environmental impact in terms of joules on your AI usage per prompt vs your other impacts like gasoline and shopping at the local supermarket. You'll find that AI is pathetically small compared to eating a hamburger.

If you want to absorb the guilt of mega corporations and nation states, consider the innocent women and children getting their schools and hospitals blown apart because of gas. You can't even post on reddit without contributing to global suffering. You're responsible for your usage you control. These systems are maintained with serious military violence, your alternative would be to run around shooting people or raising an army.

replies.author: solace1234
replies.body: The first version of your comment was a bit nihilistic but still got through to me. As for the second version… I do think you’re on the right track but I don’t have the money to really do the whole donations thing. That being said, I like your idea that my financial support of cloud-based LLMs can be offset by being even more proactive about lessening the environmentally/politically unhealthy parts of AI technology. I appreciate your perspective.

replies.author: Tarl2323
replies.body: It's not nihilism, it's realism. If you care about the environment, actually care about it. Picking AI is just social performance.

replies.author: solace1234
replies.body: Nah, i’m just admittedly ignorant to the scale of the impact that it has compared to other things. But when you mention gas, the meat industry, etc, it really puts things into perspective for me.

replies.author: Fridge333
replies.body: Going vegan is probably the greatest impact you can have on the environment, and less animals die. Ai is a drop in a bucket comparatively.

replies.author: DoggoDadagon
replies.body: I'm not sure what you guys think nihilism means but this ain't it lol. Sorry.

replies.author: solace1234
replies.body:
I didn’t say it was 100% the ultimate definition of nihilistic, jeez. Just a bit. 

And I should inform you that the original unedited comment was completely different, speaking on the idea that basically every activity in society contributes to a detriment on the planet — basically his point was that my negligible addition to the impact doesn’t matter, which is *a bit* nihilistic if you ask me, but i don’t necessarily mean that in a negative way fr…

replies.author: DoggoDadagon
replies.body:
Yeah sorry, I just always see the word used incorrectly or negatively, kinda bothers me a little haha.

I am a (optimistic) nihilist, but just because there's no intrinsic meaning to existence doesn't mean we should be terrible and not care about the experiences we create for ourselves and future generations.

You should do what feels right, I agree with you, it does matter. Personally I think supporting open models is the best thing you can do with your choice of AI usage, it helps put power into the hands of everyone rather than big companies. If you have the hardware you can try deepseek harness (open source) with an open model like qwen3.8 27B. If not, giving your support to a company dedicated to open models is the way to go.

replies.author: Tarl2323
replies.body: The truth is no one gives a flying shit about the mathematics of carbon spend and  the environment. They are looking for absolution so I changed it.

comments.author: Agitated_Quail_1430
comments.body: There are open source like qwen, but you need the hardware to run it.

comments.author: Ok-File-2759
comments.body: If they use the internet/social media on a daily basis, they shouldn’t be complaining about AI data center environmental impacts. If they actually cared so much, they would’ve been complaining the past couple decades. But I bet they use the internet/social media everyday right?

comments.author: Time_Cat_5212
comments.body: This whole way of thinking is for the birds imo.

comments.author: DoggoDadagon
comments.body:
Then run local or at least buy your sub from a company that releases open models to support their mission.

It sucks that closed models are running the show right now, but I imagine in 6 months (maybe less) we'll have open models as good as opus 5.5 and astra.

comments.author: Upstairs_Weird_760
comments.body:
If using a coding tool makes you feel like you’re personally funding the collapse of civilization, just don’t use it. But asking Reddit to morally absolve you for paying for a software subscription is a little dramatic.

You can care about AI’s environmental and economic impact without turning every hobby project into an ethics tribunal. Use it thoughtfully, don’t use it, whatever. Nobody needs to be “convinced” that they’re still a good person because they opened Chat GPT Desktop.

comments.author: Upstairs_Weird_760
comments.body: you could, idk, get the fuck off reddit. its not the real world you know.

replies.author: solace1234
replies.body: it actually kinda says a lot about you that when i say “everyone i know” you assume i’m talking about Reddit and not, like, real life lmao

comments.author: johnesco
comments.body: Using a single limited subscription that you use for a few hours a week to help you with some code is less energy used than if you have 20 accounts running bots all day.

comments.author: Felwyin
comments.body:
Only way to solve this conundrum is to buy some land and live off grid without any contact with the society.

Anything else will lead to directly invests into the oligarchs of the world and environmental destruction. 

If that's not something you are not ready to do then you must accept some negative impact and learn to evaluate what is worst/less evil. You might realize that your burger consumption has a way worst impact on our planet than your prompts.

comments.author: JorgitoEstrella
comments.body: Tell them data centers are used to store their tiktoks and cringe videos as well.
